notes.title: Preaction System Update
notes.content:
Courses for Preaction Systems using the F1 and VXD valves are now available! Learn how to place the different systems into service after installation, how they function during system activation, and the steps to take when resetting the tripped systems.

Startup, Simulation, and Reset courses have been added for the following systems:
[list]
[*] Viking VXD Double-Interlock Electric/Pneu-Lectric Preaction System
[*] Viking VXD Double-Interlock Electric/Pneumatic Preaction System
[*] Viking F-1 Double-Interlock Electric/Pneumatic Preaction System
[*] Viking F-1 Double-Interlock Electric/Pneu-Lectric Preaction System
[*] Viking VXD Single-Interlock Pneumatic Preaction System
[*] Viking VXD Single-Interlock Electric Preaction System
[*] Viking F1 Single-Interlock Electric Preaction System
[*] Viking F1 Single-Interlock Pneumatic Preaction System
[/list]

notes.title: Optimizations!
notes.content: Virtual Viking has been optimized to take advantage of advances in modern hardware. The system requirements have been updated to reflect this change. We recommend updating to the latest version to resolve any performance issues you may have encountered on previous versions. If you encounter any performance issues, please post them on the discussion board or contact our support team at digital@vikingcorp.com.

notes.title: Optimization
notes.content: Optimized for better performance. If you are encountering technical difficulties try running in desktop mode

notes.title: Product in location is now available!
notes.content:
Product in Location is the BRAND NEW Virtual Viking experience everyone needs to try!

Journey through MV Tower, a unique high-rise filled with various applications and Viking products. Users can interact with products through activation demonstrations, temperature and finish variations, and more. Deep dive into the application's details all with the palm of a virtual hand!

Participants will enjoy five realistic environments through guided tours, which provide a deeper understanding of Viking's products and various application possibilities, up-close product interactions, and much more.

The Flow lab V1 is also available through the modules tab

notes.title: OXEO System Release!
notes.content: The course for the OXEO gas system has been added!

notes.title: Full Flow Trip Test Fix
notes.content: Fixed Full Flow Trip Test step 5. The interactive sign that was no longer spawning has been re-implemented.

notes.title: Minor Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Feature Add:
> Pressing <Ctrl + Shift + C> will now reset the "Completed Courses" in the main menu, placing them back in the module section for easier navigation

Bug Fixes:
> Issues with unresponsive ball valves have been fixed
> Issues with ball valve handles clipping into adjacent geometry have been fixed
> Sprinkler audio on the Fire Cycle 3 modules now fades properly
> On the F2 Dry Valve Reset the Tire Iron snaps to the bolt until the rotation is complete. (The player doesn't pick it back up again when they try to rotate it)
> Grab indication billboards maintain a sharper resolution
> VXD panel reset is responsive
